purpose: Test whether XPU static-FP8 AsyncTP fusion closes the remaining Qwen3.8-27B TP2 c64 aggregate-throughput gap without weakening output isolation.

protected_control.relationship: immutable promoted comparison; R14 cannot replace it without a separate two-fresh-server confirmation and complete ladder

contribution.name: XPU W8A8-FP8 static GEMM collective fusion
contribution.author: chaojun-zhang
contribution.lab_ingestion: focused four-file patch stored in this repository; no external guide or cookbook is a runtime dependency
contribution.pre_model_test: upstream XPU AsyncTP unit path passed 4/4 static/dynamic all-gather+GEMM and GEMM+reduce-scatter cases on the two B70s

measurement.excluded_warmup: one identical c64 group after server health and before measurement
measurement.required_activation_gate: both ranks log direct P2P activation and at least one nonzero AsyncTP pattern replacement
measurement.required_output_gate: 64 complete 128-token responses, zero cached prompt tokens, complete raw token IDs, and no cross-base frozen-oracle collision
measurement.required_cleanup: container removed, no non-wrapper model process, and benchmark port closed

decision.promising_definition: at least 5% above the protected 774.394144 c64 median with every activation/output/cleanup gate passed
decision.if_promising: preregister a wholly fresh two-server confirmation and recover the complete c1-c64 ladder plus matching BF16 candidate-image AsyncTP-off attribution control
decision.if_below_promising: preserve as a negative or neutral diagnostic; do not promote or alter the protected result
